init_minimum_spanning_tree: init all camera poses using a minimum spanning tree from pairwise estimations
init_from_known_poses: init pairwise and image poses when all camera poses are already known
minimum_spanning_tree: build a minimum spanning tree to compute 3D points and camera poses from image pairs
fast_pnp: estimate camera pose and focal length using RANSAC-based PnP from 3D points
align_multiple_poses: align multiple source camera poses to target poses using rigid registration with scaling
